preconditions.description: The length of the string n is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.
The number of characters Vasya can change k is between 0 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'ab' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s consists only of the letters 'a' and 'b'.

postconditions.description: The maximum beauty of the string is between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: return_value <= k + max(len(list(group)) for _, group in itertools.groupby(s))
postconditions.description: The maximum beauty is the maximum length of a substring of equal letters after changing no more than k characters.
